proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free API credits daily (renewed every 24h). FLUX.1 Schnell costs 0.003 credits per image (~33,000 free images per day).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides stable, incredibly fast API endpoints for FLUX.1 Schnell, SDXL, and ControlNet. Unlike other free tiers, their credit allowance is highly generous for lightweight models and works seamlessly inside serverless environments like GitHub Actions without CORS or IP blocks.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates directly inside `produce_coloring_book` and `produce_merch_designs` as the primary image generation backend via a simple cURL/Python request with an API key.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Daily credits do not roll over; strict rate limiting under high concurrent request volume.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 50 free image generations per day on the web/API sandbox interface.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Offers superior real-time image upscaling, enhancement, and vector-style generation. It is specifically tailored for clean vector aesthetics and high-resolution POD preparation, making it perfect for turning raw generations into crisp coloring pages.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into the post-processing phase of `produce_coloring_from_cdc` to upscale raw outputs to print-ready 300 DPI vectors.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: The official developer API is in closed beta, requiring web automation or unofficial client wrappers within Termux/Actions.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to sign up and upload. No listing fees, automated storefront.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Owned by Redbubble but operates on an independent, highly optimized search algorithm. It has a massive organic reach for niche pop-culture, text-based, and minimalist designs, requiring zero ad spend.
proposals.would_integrate_where: An automated upload destination to run parallel to Redbubble inside the merch design pipelines (`produce_merch_designs`).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict copyright filter system; accounts can be suspended quickly if tags infringe on major trademarked brands.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatic reverse image search via Google Lens. It can scan top-selling POD designs on Etsy/Amazon to find exactly what style is trending or verify if a generated image is too close to an existing copyrighted work.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used in `agent_visual_audit` and `agent_trend_design_matcher` to validate that generated designs are unique and target highly-searched visual styles.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Low monthly volume on the free tier; needs to be used sparingly only for final validation of top candidates.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 50 credits per day (equivalent to 10 free songs/tracks per day on Suno's base engine).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Generates high-quality, radio-ready music, soundscapes, and loops. Perfect for creating game assets, ambient sounds for focus/meditation, or audiobooks.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into `produce_gamedev_asset_pack` to add premium audio assets (background loops, SFX) to asset bundles sold on itch.io or Unity/Godot stores.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Commercial use of the free tier tracks is legally restricted by Suno’s ToS; tracks must be heavily modified or used as placeholders unless upgraded.

proposals.tool_or_platform: Vectorizer AI (via alternative API engines like Vectorizer.io)
proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free interactive web conversions, or free credits upon account registration.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts raster PNG/JPG images into flawless, scalable SVG files using advanced geometric tracing. Far superior to standard Potrace engines for coloring books and cutting files (Cricut/SVG packs).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used inside `produce_svg_pack` and `produce_coloring_book` to convert AI-generated line art into true vector formats before packaging.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: API transitions to paid quickly; requires rotating keys or fallback to local command-line tools like `potrace` inside GitHub Actions.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 30 free generations per month via web/developer portal.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Produces highly realistic, hyper-detailed 3D assets, videos, and complex imagery from simple prompts. Unmatched in cinematic lighting and structural coherence.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used in `produce_kdp_cover` to create eye-catching, high-impact book covers that stand out against amateur designs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Slow generation times and limited free quota; best reserved strictly for high-value hero assets (like main covers).
